prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1407; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports other vehicle entered intersection against signal and struck driver's side door. Police report requested. Vehicle towed to preferred shop. Rental authorization pending.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. All further contact to be routed through attorney's office. Claimant reports headache, dizziness, and sensitivity to light following the collision. Medical authorization forms sent to attorney for signature.

Entry 3: Received treatment records from urgent care. Diagnosis noted as concussion with post-concussive symptoms. Referral to neurology on file. Reviewed photos of vehicle damage submitted by insured; intrusion to driver door panel consistent with reported impact angle.

Entry 4: Spoke with attorney's office regarding liability position. Comparative fault question raised due to conflicting witness accounts of signal phase. Requested additional witness statements and intersection camera footage if available. Attorney indicated demand package will follow once treatment concludes.

Entry 5: Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect injury severity and open medical treatment. File flagged for supervisor review due to represented claimant and disputed liability. Next action: obtain neurology report and confirm status of signal timing records from municipality.
